metaDescription: Order custom 20 oz barware in bulk. Perfect for branded glassware and drinkware. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Custom 20 oz barware hits the sweet spot between a standard rocks glass and a tall tumbler, making it a versatile choice for corporate events, hospitality branding, or promotional giveaways. This size works well for serving cocktails, beer, or non-alcoholic drinks, and it offers ample surface area for screen-printed logos or etched designs. Whether you are outfitting a company bar or sending branded glassware to clients, 20 oz barware delivers a substantial feel that stands out from smaller drinkware options.
